decisive_spans.text: Both serum amylase and lipase were elevated
Contrast‐enhanced CT and MR cholangiopancreatography demonstrated swelling of the pancreas with a peripheral rim and slight narrowing of the main pancreatic duct

response.rationale: The patient presents with pancreatic swelling and elevated serum amylase and lipase, which are direct indicators of acute pancreatitis. While chronic pancreatitis is also supported by these findings and the history of diabetes and duct narrowing, the acute elevation of enzymes and swelling point more strongly to an acute process. The other candidates are contradicted or less directly supported.
